criteria.basis: This artifact evaluates all eight acceptance criteria individually and records PASS or NOT_READY for each.
criteria.remediation: Retain this mapping with the exact checker artifacts when the SuClos validation record is available.
criteria.claimLimit: Repository audit structure is not proof of native SuClos goal completion.

criteria.basis: Catalog checker reports 68 unique IDs aligned across catalog, reconciliation, status matrix, and implementation evidence register.
criteria.remediation: Re-run the catalog alignment check only when a source revision changes.
criteria.claimLimit: This proves repository ID alignment, not packaged runtime or interoperability.

criteria.basis: Actionable closure reports zero partial/defective rows; all eight deferred rows retain source, executable evidence, dependency, next action, owner/remediation, and claim-limit records.
criteria.remediation: Use the recorded owner-specific follow-ups at an available canonical boundary; do not promote deferred rows.
criteria.claimLimit: Deferred rows are dispositioned, not claimed as runtime passes.

criteria.basis: Boundary reconciliation separates supporting-local, supporting-manual, canonical-ci, packaged-runtime, and interoperability classes and pins them to frozen revisions.
criteria.remediation: Obtain canonical CI, packaged-runtime, or interoperability evidence only at the corresponding available boundary.
criteria.claimLimit: Local/manual evidence has canonicalCiEvidence=false and cannot prove packaged or interoperability behavior.

criteria.basis: Task-specific verification reports task-specific validation records, execution/validation linkage, contract revision, four consumers, and nine closures; cancelled tasks retain explicit dispositions.
criteria.remediation: Keep cancelled-task ledger and task-specific linkage revision-pinned; do not replay stale tasks.
criteria.claimLimit: Task-specific linkage proves the named repository contract boundary only.

criteria.basis: Boundary audit reports bounded retry, non-retryable environment-unavailable outcomes, unique decision fingerprints, zero stale/cyclic/new dependencies, and no open blockers.
criteria.remediation: Repair the external workflow boundary only when a fresh validator run is available; preserve first-failure fingerprints.
criteria.claimLimit: Environment unavailability is not treated as a source failure or runtime pass.

criteria.basis: Contract verification joins the pinned contract revision to MCP export/status, Flutter assertion, fixtures, plans, and capability-map artifacts.
criteria.remediation: Reconcile consumers again only when the contract revision changes.
criteria.claimLimit: Consumer propagation is repository-level evidence; Flutter packaged execution remains deferred.

criteria.basis: Repository checks pass and this audit records not-completed, but this new task has no SuClos validation record yet; native workflow and packaged/managed Flutter boundaries remain deferred.
criteria.remediation: Run the configured independent checks through the SuClos validation boundary and repair native workflow references if validation remains unavailable.
criteria.claimLimit: This terminal audit cannot claim completed, canonical CI, packaged-runtime, or interoperability closure.

residualRequirements.remediation: Produce a SuClos validation record for this task and repair any typed execution/validation linkage that prevents verification.
residualRequirements.claimLimit: Command-level PASS is supporting evidence until SuClos validates it.

residualRequirements.remediation: Run setup, packaged launch, authenticated call, security behavior, clean stop, and compatible-client smoke at an available Flutter-capable boundary.
residualRequirements.claimLimit: Local/manual and repository evidence is not packaged-runtime or interoperability proof.

claimLimit: This is an evidence-aware repository audit. It does not mark the SuClos goal completed.
